title: Subsistence
description: A hardcore survival modpack focused on fighting challenging mobs and building practical structures and contraptions to defend yourself.
body:
The early access build of Subsistence, a hardcore survival modpack balanced for multiplayer co-op.

![Subsistence](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kKwPZSVS/images/9318a63c0be3e3321be689801906a9dfdb9a0f19.png)

Subsistence's main focus is on making the survival experience more challenging by making mobs smarter and deadlier, while also giving players ample tools to fight back. 

Build a fortified home base to fend off vicious hordes of mobs that grow stronger every 5 days.

Use Create and Scorched Guns to build defenses and weaponry.

![Scorched Guns and Create](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kKwPZSVS/images/760bdafea559d5d2675c20eefd1e6e93043e212c.png)

Use Farmer's & Miner's Delight to cook useful food items to sustain yourself.

![A Farm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kKwPZSVS/images/5b49e7f25071e1b6298e645069c7a2a426cf7b68.png)
